purpose: Teach: 軍曹/億万/而/擇/蝓/古賀/関口/渡邊

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、防衛事業で軍曹、つまり下士官教育に協力しろ
lines.en: I want the company to cooperate with military education for non-commissioned officers in our defence division.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Clean attack on each directive. No room for misunderstanding. Seated composure—this is how things are decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。富裕層、つまり億万長者向けサービスを展開します
lines.en: Yes. We'll develop wealth management services targeting high-net-worth individuals.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Steady pace, each element precise. Note-taking in the voice—capturing the directive faithfully. Professional deference without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社訓に古文の「而」、つまり「而して」を取り入れろ
lines.en: I want the company to incorporate the classical character 而 from our company philosophy—meaning 'moreover' or 'and thus'—into our corporate motto.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost scholarly in cadence. Pauses slightly before explaining the classical term. Weight on the tradition of it. Setting a standard that will outlast the moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業時の旧字「擇」、つまり選を社印に残します
lines.en: Yes. We'll preserve the original character 擇 from our founding in the company seal, representing 'choice'.
lines.style: Careful articulation. Treating the heritage with reverence—this isn't just a task, it's continuity. Slight emphasis on the preservation of founding principles.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、農業事業で蝓、つまり害虫対策を強化しろ
lines.en: I want the company to strengthen pest control measures—particularly against slugs—in our agricultural operations.
lines.style: Direct and practical. Shifts briefly from philosophical to operational. Still authoritative but grounded. The specificity lands without hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧問の古賀様にご助言を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll consult with our advisor, Koga, for guidance on this.
lines.style: Confirming action. Knows where expertise lives. Simple, efficient—no flourish. The solution is already clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、広報の関口様に取材対応を任せろ
lines.en: I'm entrusting our PR director, Sekiguchi, with media relations.
lines.style: Delegation without doubt. Brief, confident. The decision is final and the person chosen is capable. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者ご令孫の渡邊様を経営に迎えます
lines.en: Yes. We'll welcome the founder's great-grandchild, Watanabe, into our management team.
lines.style: Formal acceptance of succession. Respectful of lineage and continuity. Even in agreement, there's weight—this is a significant step. Composed resolution.
